title: Job message, version 2
description: SQS message body the API sends the solver: one run to compute. The request has already been validated, including the cross-field rules of contracts/README.md.

model_version.description: The model the params hash was computed for. A solver on another model refuses the message.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run record the solver reports into.

params_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical request, the model version and the prices' content hash, lowercase hex (contracts/README.md).

user_sub.description: Subject claim of the user who submitted the run.

prices.description: Where the solver reads the prices from.

source.description: The canonical CCEE hourly PLD packaged with the solver.
An uploaded CSV in S3, with the header hora,submercado,pld.
